notice: Weighted motif scores for the continuous engine (docs/MOTIF_SCORING.md). Design parameters chosen by MOTIF and calibrated by inspection on the 13 trial brands (reports/continuous_engine_analysis.md); they are not statistical estimates, probabilities, or measures of how strongly a brand 'is' a motif.
reads: lexicon-0.3 annotations: role 'support' counts in full; role 'context_common_cue' counts at the common-cue weight; 'negated' and 'excluded_context' never count.

formula.score: 1 - prod over channels c of (1 - weight_c * s_c); bounded to [0, 1)
formula.units_own: distinct supporting cue groups + extra_item_weight * (supporting tags - those cue groups) + common_cue_weight.own * common-only cue groups
formula.units_related: distinct supporting entities + extra_item_weight * (supporting tags - those entities) + common_cue_weight.related * entities with common cues only
formula.units_diversity: (distinct supporting cue groups - 1) + (distinct source kinds with supporting tags - 1): a motif named in one word by one kind of source gets no diversity credit

own.why: the brand's own Qloo entry describes the brand itself (the anchor); one cue group already carries most of its weight

brand.why: related brands are the second anchor; a pattern needs several of the ten related brands

movie.why: related films corroborate; film 'style' tags describe the films, not the brand

artist.why: related music artists corroborate; counted only when the session fetched them (off by default)

diversity.why: the same motif named in several different words, or by several kinds of source, is a broader pattern than one word repeated in one place

common_cue_weight.why: cue groups common in the frozen reference set (lexicon-0.3 commonness) say little about one brand; in the brand's own entry they still describe the brand, so they keep more weight there

changes.reason: Phase 4 of the engine refactor: replace binary activation (count of source kinds) with a graded, saturating score so that very different amounts of support no longer get the same label.
